_about: German texts (decision 25.11, HANDOFF section 19): page titles of the German pages and a dictionary English → German. The seed (wp amour seed) copies every field of an English page to its German page, putting each English text through this dictionary, and does the same for the questions, the topics, the map places, the menus and the texts in Hotel settings. Texts in square brackets are admin fields still to be filled: they stay as they are. The legal pages stay in English until the lawyer has checked them.
